content.text: Submission – Step-by-Step Guide
Purpose of Document

The purpose of this document is to walk you through submitting a report in the Information Reporting Application. The following reports can be electronically filed using the Information Reporting Application:

items.text: NCIR-BW, Report by Beer and Wine Wholesalers of Wholesale Sales of Alcohol
NCIR-ABC, Report by ABC Board of Wholesale Sales of Alcohol
NCIR-OL, Report by Occupational Licensing Boards of their Licensees

content.text: This guide applies to new report submissions and amended report submissions. Click the applicable **Submission** button in the Information Reporting Application to begin.

content.description: The North Carolina Department of Revenue (NCDOR) website form titled "Beer/Wine Wholesaler Submitter Information" features input fields for Year of Data, Entity Type, Entity ID, ABC Permit Number, and Legal Name.

content.text: The screen examples below are for a Beer and Wine Wholesaler submission.
Submitter Information

**Step 1:** On the Submitter Information screen, select the year for which you want to submit a report. In addition, select the company’s entity type (FEIN or SSN) and enter the company’s Entity ID and Legal or Board Name. If the entity type is FEIN, the Entity ID is the company’s FEIN number. If the entity type is SSN, the Entity ID is the company’s SSN number. **Fields with a red asterisk are required. The submitter information fields you must complete are based on the type of report being filed.**

content.description: The North Carolina Department of Revenue logo features the large blue acronym NCDOR on the left, with the full agency name stacked to the right of a vertical divider line.

content.text: **Note:** The contact information should be the person we need to contact if there is an issue with the submission or question about the report.
If a required field is not completed or you enter an invalid phone number or email address, an error message will appear once you click Next.

content.description: The North Carolina Department of Revenue web portal page for "Beer/Wine Wholesaler Submitter Information" displays a form requiring a year of data, entity type, entity ID, ABC permit number, legal name, and trade name, with navigation buttons for "Back" and "Next" at the bottom.

content.text: **Step 2:** Once you’ve entered all required submitter information, click **Next** to continue.

content.description: A pop-up alert box from the North Carolina Department of Revenue displaying a yellow warning icon and the error message "Entity Type is required," along with a "Close" button.

**Step 4:** On the Submission screen, click the **Upload** button that corresponds with the file(s) you want to upload.

content.description: A Windows file selection window displays a list of three Excel files labeled Customer TY22.xlsx, Invoice TY22.xlsx, and Product TY22.xlsx. The "Customer TY22.xlsx" file is currently highlighted, and two orange arrows point to the selected file and the "Open" button at the bottom of the window.

content.text: **Step 5:** A new window will open. Choose the file you want to upload. Click **Open** to add the file. Keep in mind:

items.text: All files must be .txt, .csv, or .xlsx format.
There are no individual file size limitations for the Information Reporting Application, but there is a 3 GB total submission size limit and your browser may have a 2 GB limitation.

content.description: The North Carolina Department of Revenue web portal for beer and wine wholesaler tax submissions shows instructions and buttons for uploading customer, product, and invoice files. The interface includes buttons to trigger file uploads for each category, which currently display zero files uploaded, and navigation buttons at the bottom.

content.text: **Step 6:** The file(s) you add will appear in a table below the upload buttons.

content.description: A row from a file list labeled "Customer Files (1)" containing a file named "Customer TY22.xlsx" with a removal icon next to it indicated by an orange arrow.

content.text: **Step 7:** If needed, use the minus **(-)** button next to the file name to delete a file. A confirmation box will appear. Click **Yes** to remove the file or **No** to keep the file.

content.description: A dialog box from the North Carolina Department of Revenue asks the user to confirm the removal of a file named Customer TY22.xlsx, featuring Yes and No buttons.

This North Carolina Department of Revenue web portal page facilitates the upload of Customer, Product, and Invoice files for Form NCIR-BW. The page includes buttons for uploading each file type and displays a table confirming that three files—Customer TY22.xlsx, Product TY22.xlsx, and Invoice TY22.xlsx—have been successfully uploaded.

content.text: **Step 8:** Once all files have been uploaded, click **Next** to continue.

content.description: A warning message from the North Carolina Department of Revenue informing the user that their current submission will replace any previously submitted records for the selected tax year, with buttons to either continue or cancel the action.

content.text: **Step 9:** A popup warning will appear to remind you that the current submission will replace all data in any previous submission for the same tax year. If you are filing an amended report, confirm you have included all data for the tax year and then click **Continue**. If you are not filing an amended report, click **Cancel** to return to the Submission screen where you can remove and/or upload files, or go back to the Submitter Information screen to correct the submission information, such as the tax year.

content.description: The North Carolina Department of Revenue portal page titled "Submission for Beer/Wine Wholesalers" displays an upload interface with three buttons for uploading Customer, Product, and Invoice files, which are currently populated with files named "Customer TY22.xlsx," "Product TY22.xlsx," and "Invoice TY22.xlsx." A "Back" button is located in the bottom-left corner, and a "Next" button with an accompanying arrow is in the bottom-right corner.

content.text: Submission Review

**Step 10:** If there are no errors in your file(s), the Submission Review screen is displayed. **Review** all of the information entered and files to be uploaded. **This is your last chance to edit report information before submitting the report.**

content.description: This web interface displays a submission review screen summarizing data provided for invoice, customer, and product files, including the number of rows and months with no wholesale sales. Below the summary, it lists the three uploaded Excel files: Customer TY22.xlsx, Product TY22.xlsx, and Invoice TY22.xlsx, with navigation buttons for "Back" and "Submit" at the bottom.

content.text: The uploaded files are shown at the bottom of the Submission Review screen.

content.description: A submission review screen from the North Carolina Department of Revenue (NCDOR) for a Beer/Wine Wholesaler. The form displays details for Testing Company, Inc., including contact information, permit number, and a checkbox to certify the accuracy of the data before final submission.

content.text: **Step 11:** If all information is correct, check the **box** at the top of the page to certify that your report is accurate and complete and then click **Submit** to continue.

content.description: A submission review webpage for the North Carolina Department of Revenue (NCDOR) displays a summary of data for a 2022 Beer/Wine Wholesaler filing, including entity information and contact details. A checkbox at the top, highlighted by an orange arrow, requires the user to certify that the information is accurate before final submission.

A web-based submission review page displaying form data including file upload counts, a summary of invoice details, and selected months with no wholesale sales. At the bottom are "Back" and "Submit" buttons, with an orange arrow pointing to the "Submit" button.

content.text: **Note:** If you click Submit without acknowledging the report is accurate and complete, a popup box will appear. Click **Close** to return to the Submission Review screen and check the acknowledgment box.

content.description: A North Carolina Department of Revenue web dialog box containing a warning icon and a request for the user to confirm that the information being submitted is accurate and complete, featuring a "Close" button.

content.text: **Step 12:** A popup box will appear while your report is being reviewed for errors. Do not close the Information Reporting Application until validation is complete.

content.description: A confirmation message from the North Carolina Department of Revenue stating that files have been processed successfully, displaying the submission ID N_47495921T364856FTHFQW and a Close button.

content.text: **Step 13:** If there are no errors in your report, you will receive a Submission ID and confirmation that your report has been processed successfully. Click **Close** to close the popup box.

content.description: A North Carolina Department of Revenue notification window displaying an error message that test files must be corrected and retested. A large orange arrow points to a "Download Error Report" button next to a "Close" button.

content.text: If there are one or more errors in your file(s), you will receive an error report. Click **Download Error Report** to open the error report.

content.description: A status screen for the North Carolina Department of Revenue indicating that a submission is currently being validated. The screen asks the user to allow up to 5 minutes for a response and displays an elapsed time counter.

content.text: If there is an error in your submission, determine where the error occurred by reviewing the error message(s) and correct your report accordingly. Use the same steps to submit your report.
Submission Completed

**Step 14:** Once your submission is complete, the Submission Completed screen is displayed. Your Submission ID is shown. You should print the confirmation page for your records. Click **Begin Another Submission** to submit another report or click **Done-Return to DOR Home Page** to return to the NCDOR website.
